LESSON: SUBTRACTION

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Numbers
Topic 1.5: Subtraction

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Subtraction. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LOOK AND LEARN

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-3/mathematics/page-145.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3 — page 145]]

From your pupil's book (page 145)

Subtraction Week 5 Lesson 4 Subtracting Two 2 - digit Numbers Examples 1. 98 -67 Steps 1. Subtract 7 ones from 8 ones to get 1 ones. 2. Subtract 6 tens from 9 98 tens to get 3 tens. -67 31

2. 72 - 30 = Steps 1. Arrange vertically. 2. Subtract 0 ones from 2 72 ones to get 2 ones. -30 3. Subtract 3 tens from 7 42 tens to get 4 tens.

Work to do Subtract 1. 57 2. 64 3. 85 - 36 - 22 - 60

Subtraction Week 5 Lesson 5 Subtracting a 1 - digit number from a 2 - digit number Example 1

Steps 1. Subtract 3 ones from 8 ones to get 5 ones. 2. Bring down 2 tens.

arrange as Steps tens ones 1. Subtract 5 ones from 7 9 9 ones to get 4 ones. - 5 2. There is no tens in the 7 4 second number. 3. Bring down 7.

Subtract 2 tens from 9 tens 872 to get 7 tens. 4. Write 8 in the hundreds place Work to to Subtract a) 378 2. 267 3. 146 - 52 - 23 -` 15

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Subtraction means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Subtraction.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Subtraction
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
3. Learning materials: Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3
4. Revise with the quiz now.
